cues.text: Here are the four options for the question we were just working on.
Option A: infrastructure governance through centralised database administration controls.
Option B: strategic alignment through enterprise digital transformation initiatives.
Option C: performance measurement through Key Performance Indicators, or KPIs, analysis.
Option D: resource optimisation through hybrid workforce restructuring initiatives.
The suggested answer is C.
Tracking KPIs is performance measurement.
Next, CA Question 30.
CA means continuous assessment.
The question reads: One common IT management challenge in Africa is what?
Option A: significant national infrastructure limitations.
Option B: problems with excessive cloud computing.
Option C: issues with extensive government regulation.
Option D: oversupply of qualified IT industry workers.
The suggested answer is A.
Unreliable power and connectivity are common infrastructure constraints.
Now CA Question 31.

Amid increasing digital competition across Nigerian banking platforms, executives at Guaranty Trust Holding Company Plc, known as GTCO, proposed integrating predictive analytics into customer service channels.
Which IT management principle is most directly demonstrated by this initiative?
Option A: strategic alignment through technology-enabled customer experience innovation.
Option B: risk mitigation through compliance enforcement and infrastructure monitoring.
Option C: performance measurement through operational dashboards and reporting controls.
Option D: resource allocation through workforce restructuring and procurement controls.
The suggested answer is A.
Customer-focused analytics aligns technology with business objectives.
Now CA Question 32.

Given unstable electricity supply across regional operations at Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited, or NNPCL, executives approved investment in resilient cloud infrastructure and backup systems.
Which challenge of IT management primarily influenced this decision?
Option A: fragmented governance caused by excessive vendor dependence strategies.
Option B: workforce dissatisfaction resulting from unclear organisational reporting lines.
Option C: weak collaboration arising from decentralised customer engagement processes.
Option D: infrastructural instability involving unreliable power and connectivity systems.
The suggested answer is D.
Unreliable electricity and connectivity are infrastructure instability.
Now CA Question 34.
Throughout a digital governance assessment at the Nigerian Communications Commission, or NCC, reviewers discovered fragmented technology assets lacking centralised oversight.
Which managerial function would best address this problem?
Option A: organising through structured coordination of tasks and decision authority.
Option B: staffing through employee recruitment and performance incentive restructuring.
Option C: controlling through operational monitoring and variance correction strategies.
Option D: directing through motivational leadership and communication enhancement plans.
The suggested answer is A.
Coordinating assets, responsibilities and authority is organising.
Now CA Question 35.
Which of the following is a key function of IT management?
Option A: manual data entry and processing.
Option B: physical filing of paper documents.
Option C: strategic alignment of technology goals.
Option D: marketing campaigns and promotions.
The suggested answer is C.
Strategic alignment is the best available option, although formally it is a principle rather than one of the five management functions.
